description: This file defines a data service module for a frontend application, handling user sessions, profiles, requests, and fees. It supports both mock/local storage and integration with a Supabase backend, providing functions for authentication, data retrieval, and updates.

methods.name: getCurrentSession
methods.description: Resolves the current auth session and user, either via Supabase or local storage.

methods.name: getCurrentProfile
methods.description: Fetches the current user's profile from the database or local storage.

methods.name: createRequest
methods.description: Creates a new service request, either via Supabase or local mock data.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user via email/password, using Supabase or local mock data.

methods.name: signInWithGoogle
methods.description: Initiates Google OAuth sign-in via Supabase.

methods.name: requestPasswordReset
methods.description: Sends a password reset email via Supabase.

methods.name: updatePassword
methods.description: Updates the current user's password after reset.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Signs out the current user from Supabase or clears local session.

methods.name: getCurrentUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current logged-in user's info, via Supabase or local storage.

methods.name: listUsers
methods.description: Lists user profiles from Supabase or local mock data.

methods.name: approveMechanic
methods.description: Approves a mechanic user, updating their profile in Supabase or local data.

methods.name: listRequests
methods.description: Retrieves service requests, with manual join to profiles, from Supabase or local mock data.

methods.name: updateRequest
methods.description: Updates a request's status or assigned mechanic, via Supabase or local data.

methods.name: getFees
methods.description: Fetches fee configuration from Supabase or local storage.

methods.name: setFees
methods.description: Updates fee configuration in Supabase or local storage.

methods.name: isSupabaseConfigured
methods.description: Checks if Supabase environment variables are set.

methods.name: getSupabaseClient
methods.description: Returns the singleton Supabase client if configured.

methods.name: getMyProfile
methods.description: Loads the current user's profile from Supabase.
